entities.summary: Papyrus 20, designated by 𝔓20, is an early copy of the New Testament in Greek. It is a papyrus manuscript of the Epistle of James, but it only contains verses 2:19–3:9. The manuscript has been paleographically assigned to the early 3rd century.
